questions.explanation: Berryman emphasizes that material currency cannot compensate for emotional loss; the boy must internalize the experience of loss to grow up.

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of 'Poetic License' as demonstrated in Carolyn Wells' 'How to Tell Wild Animals'.
